rows.label: Jesuit Refugee Service total expenditure, all offices, 2025 (US$)

source.title: Jesuit Refugee Service, Annual Report 2025, Walking with refugees, against the odds (published July 2026)

rows.explainer: The network-wide figure for all JRS regional and country offices and the international office in Rome, in US dollars as published: programmes $83.9m (90%), management and administration $7.5m (8%), fundraising $2.2m (2%). The annual report doesn't say it is audited: each regional office is financially autonomous and audited on its own, and the international office's own audited accounts (Crowe Bompani, latest 2023) cover only projects coordinated from Rome, so this summary is the only account of the whole organisation. Read by both of charityevals' JRS models for the overhead multiplier.

rows.label: Jesuit Refugee Service programme expenses, all offices, 2025 (US$)

source.title: Jesuit Refugee Service, Annual Report 2025, Walking with refugees, against the odds (published July 2026)

rows.explainer: The nine programmes' expenses (p. 33): education in emergencies $34.1m, livelihoods $12.7m, emergency aid $10.0m, protection and legal advice $8.2m, mental health and psychosocial support $8.1m, advocacy and communication $4.4m, pastoral $3.0m, reconciliation $2.8m, health care $0.6m. By region: southern regions $55.7m, Europe $23.3m, North America $4.1m, international office $0.8m.
